Card Q&A.a: [Security] effects take precedence for activation. Upon a security check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation. For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.
Card Q&A.q: In what order do a [Security] effect, "when [...] performs a security check" effect, and "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect activate when they trigger simultaneously upon a security check?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, another security check is performed.
Card Q&A.q: A Digimon that has this card in its digivolution cards attacks, and a security check was performed on my opponent's security stack. If the attacking Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards digivolves into a Digimon with  using this card's inherited effect, is another security check performed?

Card Q&A.a:
The top card of the security stack. Upon a security check, the checked card is already considered to be removed from the security stack, therefore that card won't be trashed.
